fields.statement: At 328e4c60f I built rhiza with -trimpath and ran rhiza docs --out into a copy of docs/reference: no diff from the committed docs/reference, and config.md shows rhiza.daemon.autoUpdate with type off or main, default off, and latest and release named as coming with the release channels milestone. go test -trimpath ./internal/doclinks -run TestDocsDescribeAutoUpdate passes (TestRepoDocsLinksResolve too). In a git archive copy, renaming rhiza.daemon.autoUpdate in docs/runs-and-daemon.md made it fail, and adding selfUpdate to it made it fail. docs/runs-and-daemon.md names autoUpdate with off and main and no longer names selfUpdate or self_update_project. go test ./internal/docs and ./internal/api -run 'Setting|Docs' pass.
